title: The Sunhat is Everywhere in Athens as Crowds Grow Larger at Ancient Sites
description: Outside the Acropolis, a sea of hats bobs up and down the hill to the ancient site: straw boaters, Panama hats, baseball caps and bucket hats in the relentless heat. Hat racks are hard to miss in central Athens this summer. Kiosks and stores keep outdoor stands piled high as more tourists seek relief from the midday heat.

title: Simulation shows exactly what happened to victims of ancient Greek torture method called the ‘worst way to die’
description: A simulation has shown exactly what victims of an ancient Greek torture method reportedly endured after being locked inside a bronze structure.
